svg.title: Amiga workflow from selection to closure
svg.desc: Capture readiness lets a user save a plan, start a saved plan or resume the recorded checkout. Select single or combined delivery from ready sources and reconcile code, tests and docs. An authorized checkpoint continuation collects due primary reports before an advisory reviewer upholds findings for repair or rejects them to close the issue. A tested unchanged tip or an accepted full integration meets at the sealed commit, where the full English scan precedes conditional publication. The surviving record supports optional push, graph refresh, capture interval closure, preservation and authorized cleanup.
svg.text: Amiga workflow from selection to closure
Commit IDs · B is the recorded local master tip · C is the final accepted commit for publication
